payload_en.headline: Wrestler Aman Sehrawat wins Asian Games men's 57kg gold medal

paragraphs.text: Wrestler Aman Sehrawat won the men's 57kg gold medal at the Asian Games.
Wrestler Aman Sehrawat defeated Chong Song Han 11-7 in the final.
On Saturday, the wrestler defeated Aiaal Belolyubskii 14-8 in the semifinals.
